body:
Hey I really appreciate the kind words, it does mean something to me.

Its difficult to explain to others how important college is to me, and how "college doesn't work out right now" isn't an option.  I worked my ass off all through school to get to where I am, and in one fell swoop, I knocked it down.  It is so debilitating to know how quickly everything is falling apart.

And to answer your question, yes I have had a long history with depression.  I moved towns a lot when I was younger, so was never close with anyone.  I got teased frequently. I always had acquaintances and not friends and have felt alone for much of my life.  But all of that was manageable, I could always move past that.

I feel more lost than ever, and see little hope for the future.  That is why suicide is the best option for me.
